manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Recalls stored memories and conversation context from the brainstem's JSON memory store, per-user or shared.
manifest.name: @kody-w/context_memory_agent

full_recall.description: Optional flag to return all memories without filtering. Default is false.

keywords.description: Optional list of keywords to filter memories by. Only messages containing these keywords will be included.

max_messages.description: Optional maximum number of messages to include in the context. Default is 10.

user_guid.description: Optional unique identifier of the user to recall memories from a user-specific location.
